text:
olivia: Hey — can someone take eyes on this PR? https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/482
olivia: It updates route propagation for the GPU pool VPC (gpu-pool-2) and adjusts the route to the transit-gw. Also marks the old NAT GW for replacement. Hoping to merge before tomorrow's capacity window.
olivia: TL;DR risk: route table swap may cause ~30s flow disruption for a subset of instances. I added canary plan and a rollback step.
raj: I'll look in a bit, leaving a quick note: do we have a rollback playbook linked in the PR?
taylor: Can you paste the tf diff for the route block here?
olivia: Sure — excerpt below:
```
resource "aws_route" "to_transit_gw" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.gpu_rt.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  transit_gateway_id     = aws_ec2_transit_gateway.tgw.id
  depends_on             = [aws_route_table_association.gpu_assoc]
}

# replace old nat gw
resource "aws_route" "old_nat_revoke" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.gpu_rt.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  gateway_id             = aws_nat_gateway.old.id
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = false
  }
}
```
olivia: I also added a simple canary: attach one instance to a secondary route table, switch it, verify metrics for 5m, then promote.
ci-bot: terraform plan (PR#482) — success · no changes that require manual approval
raj: quick thought — lifecycle block ok, but can you add a note to the PR about tagging the new route_table associations? last time untagged RTs caused confusion with autoscale rules.
taylor: Also verify subnet tag propagation: autoscaling and placement policies rely on `redwood:gpu-pool` tag.
kevin: I'll run a perf check on a dev cluster after the plan; if green, happy to approve. :thumbsup:
olivia: Thanks — will add tags and update the PR description with the rollback steps (force-route revert + restore NAT association).
raj: small nit: change the depends_on to the association resource name so apply order is explicit.
olivia: Good catch — fixing now.
ci-bot: terraform plan (PR#482) — updated plan OK
kevin: LGTM from me once the tags are in place
taylor: LGTM for routing parts; leaving subnet tag check to kevin in dev test
olivia: Appreciate it all — will merge after one more green dev run. Leaving a merge hold until 12:00 UTC tomorrow to align with capacity maintenance window. :lock:
kevin: Sounds good, ping if you want me to fast-track after the dev run.
olivia: Will do — thanks everyone!
